title: TEC WGs Weekly Update: June 27 - July 03

posts.cooked:
Monday, July 4th, 2022

Hello! Here are the Working Group Weekly Updates for the week of June 27 - July 3. You can see what’s going on here on the calendar. You may join us in real time during any of the syncs or check out our YouTube channel archive for hundreds of recorded calls.

Stewards

Stewards: Tamara, Nate
Weekly Sync: Tuesday, 1PM EST/7PM CET

  • We are at sprint #38. Here is the sprint board so you can see what is going on.
  • We’ve been talkin about Mitch’s Post about reducing the rewards for regular paid contributor, and we’ll have a call to talk about it in depth.
  • Chuy and Mert are currently working on a document on Updates on the Proposal Inverter.
  • Remember that you can easily help the TEC by retweeting

Gravity

Steward: Juan
Weekly Sync: Wednesday, 11AM EST/5PM CET

  • The Third Graviton Training is ongoing. You can check the study plan here
    • Sessions are on Tuesdays at 8PM CET
    • Next session, number #7, will be facilitated by Loie, we will be talking about Decentralized Dispute Resolution.
  • Join us on Mondays for observational research on psychology and wellbeing.
  • On Tuesdays we have the Umbrella coordination call in Aragon at 11 AM CET
  • On Fridays we have our website desing call at 8PM CET.
  • If you’re in need of help managing a conflict, you can make a request through our typeform
